Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (February 9, 2023) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation, Ariba Document Number 3754618822 Description: For the non-exclusive supply, delivery and warranty of Resident Bed Parts, Control Units and Bed Remotes for Seniors Services and Long-Term Care Division for a period of one (1) year, with the option to renew the contract for four (4) additional one (1) year period.
